summary: Updated libreoffice package fixes security vulnerabilities
details:
Arbitrary file write via calcext:data-mappings, sql provider and
Firebird backup functionality. (CVE-2026-63266)
LFI and GET SSRF via calcext:data-mappings and csv provider.
(CVE-2026-63267)
LFI via calcext:data-mappings, sql provider and sdbc:flat:file:// db
href. (CVE-2026-63268)
LFI and GET SSRF via GStreamer and HLS playlists. (CVE-2026-63269)
Environment/ini-file leaks. (CVE-2026-63270)
Heap buffer overflow in WMF text record import. (CVE-2026-63272)
Heap buffer overflow in PDF import encryption handling. (CVE-2026-63273)
Heap buffer overflow in PDF import stream handling. (CVE-2026-63274)
Stack buffer overflow in CFF font hint handling. (CVE-2026-63275)
Stack buffer overflow in CFF to Type 1 font conversion. (CVE-2026-63276)
RCE via calcext:data-mappings, sql provider and jdbc connector.
(CVE-2026-63277)
Package URLs can be used to exfiltrate arbitrary INI file values and
environment variables. (CVE-2026-63278)
Out of bounds read in PICT image import. (CVE-2026-63279)
